The map link is a roll (risk 0.2, unsourced); its failure is the chart's UNABLE TO LINK MAP...
entries.answer: Routes are deterministic. UNABLE TO LINK MAP TO OTHER EVIDENCE is reached by breaking the statue and letting the time run out, not by a failed link; the old route risks are gone but the map link still rolls 0.2
entries.source: PowerPyx pp.txt line 145 ('Break the statue and wait for time to run out'), reader comment on patch 1.05; template timeout section is the only failure
entries.fix: C20 option 18 (LINK MAP TO OTHER EVIDENCE): remove risk 0.2 and the fail branch in ch29.mjs room() linkMap; UNABLE TO LINK stays recorded via the timeout path (mapUnlinked when d.map and time runs out)
